title: Null It Out: Guarding Protected Attributes by Iterative Nullspace Projection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating linear separability of gender in word embeddings, measuring clustering metrics (K-means V-measure, t-SNE), applying the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT), calculating bias-by-neighbors, and measuring the True Positive Rate gap (TPR-GAP) between male and female individuals in predicting professions from biographies.
Measuring the True Positive Rate gap (TPR-GAP) in sentiment classification performance between tweets authored by African American English (AAE) speakers and Standard American English (SAE) speakers.
